With /api/auth/login unreachable, every gated test (USER /shop renderer, BlockEditor stable-key, AdminProducts extras, system-wallet, location forwarding) cannot be exercised end-to-end. critical_code_review_comments: ShopBlock.jsx (61 lines): clean dispatcher, RENDERERS map + PRODUCT_BLOCK_TYPES Set is idiomatic, useMemo deps [needsProducts, b, allProducts] are correct (b is referentially stable per block).

blocks.jsx itemKey() uses image_data_url.slice(-12) — for very large dataURL images two distinct images could theoretically share the same last 12 chars (PNG IEND footer). Probability is negligible in practice (idx is included), but if author wants belt-and-suspenders, increase slice depth to 24 or hash the URL.

BlockEditor.jsx _key generator uses Date.now()+random — collision-free in practice; falls back to `existing_${idx}` for items loaded from server which do NOT have _key. That fallback is still index-keyed so the delete-middle survival property only holds for items added in the current editor session, NOT for items loaded from a saved block. Worth a follow-up: synthesize a _key on load (e.g., useEffect after setting form from `block`) so editing saved blocks behaves the same.

AdminProducts.jsx key=${u.slice(-16)}-${i}: with data-URLs the last 16 chars are part of the base64 image payload — collision-resistant for distinct uploads. Index is appended which means deleting from middle still re-indexes downstream keys (i changes) and re-mounts those nodes. The stated 'survival' guarantee only holds for items *before* the deletion point; items after will re-mount. If the goal is full survival, drop the `-${i}` suffix and rely on a longer slice (e.g., -32) or a stored synthetic id.
BlockEditor useMemo for pickableProducts: deps [products, form.product_ids] — form.product_ids is replaced on every togglePid, so memo invalidates correctly. Good. No stale-closure risk.

rca of the issue: External Emergent deployment 'network-pay-1' is offline (returns 'Deployment not found'). The slang-commerce preview ingress that used to proxy /api/* to that deployment is consequently returning 404 for all /api routes. Login fails -> no authenticated context -> none of the protected pages (/shop with shop-blocks, /admin/*) can mount their data. Reproduction: curl -s -X POST https://network-pay-1.emergent.host/api/auth/login -d '{...}' -> 'Deployment not found'. Mitigation: redeploy the network-pay-1 Emergent job, OR point the preview ingress at a different healthy backend. No frontend code change needed.
